lens: Skeptic, geometry first; measure everything. Scripts and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/2fb1f2ef-fbd7-5fb9-b7d2-14a3db7265c8/scratchpad/raterA48. They are the w47 scripts with the boxes unchanged, re-pointed to r48 (candidate) and r47 (before). blend.py makes blends and edge overlays. m2.py is the near-cover component. m3.py traces the back tops. m4/m6/m8.py cover the arm white runs, belt colours, teal area and the pocket column profile. m9.py gives the left-screen tops. m10.py gives the q15 dark runs (cover / pillow) and colour boxes. m1.py counts dark-neutral px, m7.py is the pocket colour, w.py the q15 cover runs. Crops show render | photo | w47: near17.png, arm17.png, belt17.png, pocket17.png and q15c.png, plus studio48.png (s48 e2/e3/e7/e6).
calibrationNote: Same as w47 (8.4); the detail mean is 8.29 (w47 8.28). Camera check (blend_q17.png): the arm noses and pan fronts still agree within about 5 px. The upper residual I put on the camera in w47 (w47a-L1) was absorbed by the 4.5 % shorter back. The near right back top is now y 139-144 against 151-155 (w47: 125). The near left screen top at x 60 is 175 against 178 (w47: 158). Most of the +27 px offset is therefore gone, and about 10 px remains on the near right back. The cost shows in q15: the back top there was about 7 px high in w47 and is now about 5 px low. The headrest cover moved down with it, so its top is 254-256 against 240 for E/F and 270 against 251 for D/G. The cover now sits about 17 px below the back top against the photo's ~8 px. That is a small new mismatch. The pocket got taller (pass on height) but reads as a black flat grille. The aisle-end arm gap grew from 5 to 15 px but is still two parallel bars. The headrest cover in q17 got smaller (84 x 90 against 106 x 110), and the forward bulge of the head cushion is still missing. Net: gains and losses cancel, so no change.

issues.title: Headrest cover still ~30 % too small in q17 and no convex head cushion (carried w47a-1, now 84x90 vs 106x110)
issues.evidence: covers.png / near17.png: area 3831 vs >= 5119, height 90 vs 110. In the photo the cover drapes over a cushion whose wing bulges forward and down to y~300; the render pad stops flat at ~y 245.
issues.fix: As w47a-1: cushion front forward 4-6 cm with rounded wings; lengthen the cover's front flap 3-4 cm down; keep head-on width. Move the cover's top edge up ~2 cm on the back (see w48a-4) so that the q15 top rises while the q17 flap grows downward.
issues.check: q17 near cover area >= 4900, height >= 105; q15 E/F cover top 240-248; q15 E run 68-76.

issues.title: Aisle-end arm: still two parallel white bars; lower member 24 px high and not a forward-down dogleg
issues.evidence: arm17.png, studio48 e3: x 600 render cap 416-441, gap 15, member 456-464; photo cap 419-434, gap 45, member 480-492, sloping ~19 px between x 640 and 560. The w48 drop of 4.5 cm gave only +10 px.
issues.fix: Shape the end plate as a dogleg: from the rear pivot under the cap, run down and forward to about pan-nose height (another ~5 cm lower at the front), sloping ~15-20 deg. Optionally a satin-grey upper face.
issues.check: x 600: >= 30 px non-white between cap and member; the member is >= 12 px lower at x 560 than at x 640.

issues.title: Seat-back pocket now tall but a flat dark grille: no lit mesh, no bow, card hidden
issues.evidence: pocket17.png / studio48 e6: pocket box L74, B/R 1.17, 57 % px L<70, vs photo L88, B/R 1.49, 49 %. Mesh column L 2-50 vs photo highlights 168-175. w47 (short) read L93. The enlarged #24262c backing quad (0.15 tall at on(0.01)) now dominates the strands.
issues.fix: Lift the backing to a blue-grey (~#3a4258) or push it 1 cm further behind. Lighten and thicken the strands (~#b0b6c2, 2 mm). Bow the pouches 3-4 cm at the bottom with a lit grey hem. Show the card's top edge above the pouch mouth.
issues.check: Pocket box L 82-95, B/R >= 1.3, with px L>150 >= 15 %; card visible in e6.

issues.title: q15: after the back shortening the headrest cover sits ~14-19 px low on the back
issues.evidence: q15c.png / m10: cover dark run E/F 256-310 vs 240-304; D/G 270-304 vs 251-282 (w47: 244 / 263). The back top is ~5 px low; the cover-top-to-back-top gap is ~17 px vs ~8.
issues.fix: Raise the cover/pad mount about 2 cm on the back (or scale the back about a lower point so that the head zone keeps its height), keeping the q17 back-top gain.
issues.check: q15 E/F cover top 240-248; q17 near back top within 10 px.

issues.title: Belts: teal strap now too short and the tongue is still hidden under the arm; navy slightly dark
issues.evidence: belt17.png: teal px 347 vs 758 (w47 693); light-neutral px above the arm 2 vs 13; navy L60 vs 70; buckle L198 vs 222.
issues.fix: Run the teal from the back crease diagonally to a steel tongue lying on the pan ~3 cm inboard of and above the arm line; navy toward #3a4560; buckle cover ~#d0d8e2.
issues.check: q17 teal px 600-850; tongue light px >= 8; navy L 65-75; buckle L >= 210.

issues.evidence: Mid-arm dark-neutral 521 vs 128; cap B/R 1.01 vs 1.07, lit face 25 vs 15 px; cover F L62 vs 45.

issues.title: Possible residual q17 camera term ~5-10 px (q15 now 5 px low while q17 is 10 px high)
